item.title: Dozens March in D.C. in Solidarity with Immigrants, Women’s Rights
item.description: On International Women's Day, activists gathered in Northwest D.C.'s Meridian Hill Park to celebrate the strength and power of women while protesting against attacks on immigrants, reproductive rights, and other freedoms. item.title: Juror Pay Gap in D.C. Courts Targeted in New Bill
item.description: Del. Eleanor Holmes Norton (D) has reintroduced the District of Columbia Juror Pay Parity Act, which would require D.C. Superior Court to pay jurors the same amount provided in federal courts, in order to ensure fairness in the jury system. The post Juror Pay Gap in D.C. Courts Targeted in New Bill appeared first on The Washington Informer.

item.title: Suspect Arrested, Identified in Shooting at Rihanna’s Los Angeles Home
item.description: A 35-year-old woman was arrested for firing an AR-15-style rifle at the home of global music star Rihanna and her partner A$AP Rocky, while they were on the property with their three children and household staff. The post Suspect Arrested, Identified in Shooting at Rihanna’s Los Angeles Home appeared first on The Washington Informer.

item.title: Labor Market Weakens Nationwide While D.C. Tops U.S. Unemployment List
item.description: Washington, D.C. recorded the highest unemployment rate in the nation in 2025, with Black workers being hit hardest by the weakening labor market, experiencing a Black to white unemployment ratio of two to one. The post Labor Market Weakens Nationwide While D.C. Tops U.S. Unemployment List appeared first on The Washington Informer.

item.title: Major Retailers Say Tariffs Are Forcing Price Hikes
item.description: Major American corporations are warning investors that President Donald Trump's tariffs are raising prices, forcing companies to scale back business plans, and placing growing pressure on lower-income consumers while wealthier households continue to spend. The post Major Retailers Say Tariffs Are Forcing Price Hikes appeared first on The Washington Informer.

item.title: MAGEE: America Is Experiencing the Age of the Dominus — Our Moment of Truth
item.description: The U.S. is experiencing a crisis of language as power becomes increasingly personalized and institutions become reoriented around individuals, leading to a weakening of checks and balances and the normalization of exceptional executive power. item.title: Creatives Behind WNO’s ‘Treemonisha’ Dish Themes Behind the Scenes
item.description: Washington National Opera's production of Scott Joplin's "Treemonisha" is a 70-year legacy of unconventional empowerment, featuring an all-Black cast and crew, original music, and a new stage, and is set to inspire audiences with its message of hope, joy, and agency. The post Creatives Behind WNO’s ‘Treemonisha’ Dish Themes Behind the Scenes appeared first on The Washington Informer.

item.title: After National Organizers’ Announcement, D.C. Target Boycott Organizers Plan a Pivot
item.description: The "Mothership Three" has ended their nationwide boycott of Target, which had caused the company to lose $12 billion in valuation, after Target agreed to invest $2 billion in Black-owned brands, media, and suppliers, as well as $100 million in grants and scholarships to Black-led organizations. The post After National Organizers’ Announcement, D.C. Target Boycott Organizers Plan a Pivot appeared first on The Washington Informer.

item.title: Four Regional HBCU Choirs Join Baltimore Symphony Orchestra for GospelFest Tribute to Richard Smallwood
item.description: The Baltimore Symphony Orchestra will honor the late gospel composer Richard Smallwood at its annual GospelFest concert on April 9, featuring four HBCU choirs and special guest Maurette Brown Clark.
